tooling.message:
docs(site): the workshop page in the style of the lifecycle page from #116

## Intent

The workshop page was noisy. Show the same content as calmly as the lifecycle page drafted in #116, without its striped background.

## Key changes

- The phases are a timeline: per phase its question, what the person decides with the checkpoint, and the building blocks as quiet boxes with kind, who works with them and a link.
- What a box does for the person and the agent opens on hover and keyboard focus; on touch it stands in the card.
- The band of what runs through every phase has a plain tint instead of stripes.
- The mapping says per box what it does for the agent and, where the person works with it, for the person. The attention bar, the lists per lane and the coloured kind chips are gone.
- Light, dark and 390 px checked.
